scope: One local team, work items grouped by project, a three-state workflow, and discussion.

actors.manager: Creates, assigns, advances, comments, and reads.

use_cases.name: Create work item
use_cases.trigger: An allowed actor submits a project and title.
use_cases.result: A new item is in backlog with version 1 and no assignee.

criteria.text: A valid item stores project, title, description, priority, backlog status, and version 1.
A viewer or invalid required fields cannot create an item.

use_cases.name: Assign work item
use_cases.trigger: A manager names an assignee and the expected version.
use_cases.result: The assignee is recorded and the version increases.

criteria.text: Only a manager can assign an existing item.
A stale version is rejected without overwriting a newer assignment.

use_cases.name: Advance work item
use_cases.trigger: An allowed actor requests the next state with the expected version.
use_cases.result: The item advances backlog → in_progress → done, one step at a time.

criteria.text: A valid next step changes the state and increases the version.
A skipped step or stale version is rejected without changing the item.

use_cases.name: Add comment
use_cases.trigger: An allowed actor submits comment text for an existing item.
use_cases.result: A comment records author, text, and time without changing the item version.

criteria.text: A valid comment is retained with its actor and timestamp.
A viewer, empty text, or absent item cannot add a comment.

use_cases.name: View board
use_cases.trigger: An actor requests the board, optionally filtering project or state.
use_cases.result: Matching work items are returned without mutation.

criteria.text: An allowed actor can see all items or only a selected project or state.
An unknown state filter is rejected.

use_cases.name: View comments
use_cases.trigger: An actor requests discussion for an item.
use_cases.result: Its comments are returned in time order without mutation.

criteria.text: An allowed actor can read an item's comments, including an empty list.
An absent item is reported as absent.
